text:
maria: Quick sync: pin metadata precedence across tenant overrides. Wanted to capture edgecases before RFC follow-up.

kevin: TL;DR proposal: canonical precedence order = explicit-request > hard-tenant-pin > soft-tenant-pin > system-default. Hard pins have absolute immunity to preemption unless override token present.

jess: Examples? Client pin with lower priority still should preempt soft-tenant? I thought priority numeric overrides origin.

maria: Good q. We considered two axes: origin (client/tenant/system) and enforcement (soft/hard) + numeric priority. Order should be: if enforcement differs, hard wins regardless of numeric priority unless explicit override header present.

sahil: Concern: this makes tenant hard-pin catastrophic for users if mis-set. Need TTL + kill-switch. Suggest hard pins require metadata flag "sealed":true and require owner and rollback token.

kevin: +1. Also add "pinned_by" and "pin_reason" strings for ops audit.

jess: For client-side merging rules, let's define when merge happens vs when client pin is rejected. Proposed algorithm:

- if request.pin.enforcement == "hard" and existing.pin.enforcement == "hard" => reject unless override_token present
- else if request.pin.priority > existing.pin.priority => accept
- else reject

maria: I'll sketch schema (compact to keep network payload small):

```json
{
  \"pin\": {
    \"version\": \"sha256:abcd1234\", 
    \"enforcement\": \"soft|hard\", 
    \"origin\": \"client|tenant|system\", 
    \"priority\": 100, 
    \"expires_at\": \"2026-04-01T12:00:00Z\", 
    \"sealed\": false, 
    \"pinned_by\": \"team-name\", 
    \"pin_reason\": \"safety-blocker\", 
    \"override_token\": null
  }
}
```

kevin: Telemetry: we need token-level counters for pin_hit/pin_miss and a histogram for pin_lifetime. Add pin_origin and enforcement as labels.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout of pin-handling v2 to staging started (deploy/4577) :rocket:

sahil: Ops playbook: if a tenant sets sealed hard pin, support should have a one-click rollback in console that issues override_token with short-lived ephemeral key and logs auditor.

jess: Edgecases: what about multi-model rollouts (cohort)? We should allow a "group_pin" that references multiple model ids and has atomicity semantics. Group pin should be only tenant/system origin.

maria: Next steps: I'll convert to RFC appendix w/ precise state machine and merge matrix. @kevin @jess please add test vectors (invalid sequences + expected resulting pin). :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll add unit tests and a quick migration plan for older pins (map enforcement default=soft). Will ping infra for migration window.
